title: Pay for orchestras today compared with the old brass band
summary: Ballariel says modern orchestras make far more than the brass band did, and brass bands have largely vanished.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I didn't drop it. We had $2.50 or $3.00 for an hour. The musicians and I were getting $10, $12, $15 for them. Yeah, that's right. They'd only go out now. Most of us are orchestras around here now. There's no brass bands around there except them few fellows was trying to hold up the Excelsis' name during the connoisseur time. They'd get some work. But otherwise, there's all orchestras around here now. And them fellows that get $10, $12, $15 every time they go out and play. They'd play sometime, extra hours at night, they'd come back with $20, $25 each in their

Yeah, the orchestra's getting good money around here now. In fact, everybody's getting good money except them. Yes, that's right. Poor common labor. He's doing pretty good too. But they're getting better pay now than they ever get it since mobile or been a mobile. Since the South has been a South of them.
